description: This PHP source file defines the ViewMappingProperties class, which extends the ViewList class. It handles the display logic for mapping properties in a connector module within the SuiteCRM system, including rendering connector field mappings and generating related JavaScript code.

classes.name: ViewMappingProperties
classes.description: A view class responsible for managing the display and processing of connector mapping properties within the SuiteCRM Connectors module.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sets display options such as showing JavaScript, hiding header/footer, then calls the parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the logic for rendering the mapping properties interface, including fetching connector data, generating dynamic JavaScript, and assigning variables for the Smarty template.
